It also serves as a reminder of the prophetic hadith, "Allah loves those who love Him and those who greet Him (with Salam) in the mornings and evenings" (Bukhari). By giving their child this name, parents are wishing for a deep love and commitment to Allah, and a desire for continued spiritual growth.
